lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] {f : E → ℝ},
  Continuous f →
    ∀ {z x₀ : E},
      IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
        ∀ {R ε : ℝ},
          0 < R →
            0 < ε →
              ‖z - x₀‖ ≤ R →
                have δ := ε / R ^ 2;
                have W := fun x => f x + δ / 2 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2;
                ∃ w, IsMinOn W Set.univ w ∧ ‖w - x₀‖ ≤ ‖z - x₀‖ ∧ ∀ (x : E), W x - W w ≤ ε / 2 → f x - f z ≤ ε
approved_definition_context: NormedAddCommGroup is an additive commutative group with a real-valued norm inducing its metric topology. ProperSpace means every closed metric ball is compact.
Continuous is continuity for these topologies. IsMinOn g Set.univ a means g(a)<=g(x) for every x in the domain.
have-bindings in the proposition define local expressions; the existential witness is followed by conjunctions. Norms are nonnegative real numbers.
